name: department cases
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(emp.department, 'Not Set') AS department,
    COUNT(dc.name) AS total_cases
FROM
    `tabDisciplinary Case` dc
LEFT JOIN
    `tabEmployee` emp
        ON emp.name = dc.employee_id   -- emp_id correct join
WHERE
    dc.docstatus != 0      -- Excluded Draft cases
GROUP BY
    emp.department
ORDER BY
    emp.department;
